author: Felizia
label: croc1
prompt:
ACTION: the dapper crocodile gentleman from image 1 strides cheerfully into a bank vault, taps along a wall of small golden safe-deposit boxes with his cane, stops at one, turns a tiny key and swings its little door wide open.
SHOT: medium-wide tracking shot following him from the side, 35mm lens, slow steady move of a few centimetres.
PLACE: a grand bank vault, polished marble floor, a huge round steel vault door standing open in the background, a wall of small brass safe-deposit boxes.
LIGHT: one warm key from a lamp camera-left, about 3:1, a golden glow.
SOUND: soft webbed waddling footsteps, the heavy clunk of a vault door, the little click and creak of the small box opening; no voices, no music.
